from example.Person import Person


class Employee(Person):
    def __init__(self, aName, aAge, aId):
        self._id = aId
        super().__init__(aName, aAge)

    def setId(self, aId):
        self._id = aId
        return True

    def getId(self):
        return self._id

    def delete(self):
        super().delete()

    def __str__(self):
        return (super().__str__() + "["
                + "id:" + str(self.getId())
                + "]")
